evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Matched grammatical structure ('A rollback we have not X' / 'a rollback we do not Y') sets rehearsed-vs-not-rehearsed as deliberate contrast within one frame — parallel antithesis.

mints.name: RuleAsMatchedOpposition
mints.title: a thing we have not rehearsed is a thing we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is the rule here crystallized into matched opposed clauses that make the contrast itself the argument?
